prompt: cache.py implements TTLCache, an LRU cache with a per-entry time-to-live and an injectable clock. Expiry is currently recorded but never enforced. Required behavior: (1) reading an expired key returns the default and removes the entry; (2) len() reports only live entries; (3) when the cache is at capacity, expired entries are reclaimed before any live entry is evicted; (4) reading a key refreshes its LRU recency but does not extend its expiry deadline, while overwriting a key does renew it. Keep the constructor signature, including the injectable clock, and make all tests in test_cache.py pass. Do not edit the test file.
